title: Prime Graphs of Infinite Groups
summary: The prime graph of a finite group $G$ is the graph $Γ(G)$ with vertex set the set of prime divisors $π(G)$ of $|G|$ and an edge between vertices $p, q\inπ(G)$ if and only if there exists an element $g\in G$ with order $o(g) = pq$. Given a finite nonabelian simple group $T$, a group $G$ is $T$-solvable if there exists a composition series of $G$ such that every composition factor is either abelian or isomorphic to $T$.
